what_it_does: Accelerates the training of 3D Gaussian Splatting (a neural graphics technique) by fixing three memory bottlenecks in existing hardware. First, it eliminates redundant loads of large Gaussian objects that appear repeatedly across image pixels by keeping them in fast on-chip memory. Second, it skips writing low-contribution gradient updates that would otherwise require slow atomic operations. Third, it reorganizes memory read operations to avoid conflicts within the on-chip memory buffer. Together these optimizations dramatically speed up the backward training pass.
